title: Delegating Earth science model calibration to knowledge-guided LLM agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.18378v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Applying process-based Earth science models to new sites and questions often requires expert calibration decisions. Reliable delegation to language-model agents must preserve scientific competence and reproducibility. Here we develop a general calibration harness (GCH) for end-to-end delegation from a calibration request to assessed results. Constrained by a knowledge infrastructure (KI) and a validation convention, agents define parameter domains, observation mappings and objectives, and generate model-specific code. GCH checks the formulations against the same declarations and freezes them before numerical search and assessment, which require no further agent judgement. Agent-authored workflows executed across six model families, with assessment identifying unmet criteria. translated_title: 将地球科学模型校准委托给知识引导的大语言模型智能体
translated_abstract: 将基于过程的地球科学模型应用于新的站点和问题，通常需要专家做出校准决策。而将任务可靠地委托给语言模型智能体，必须保持科学能力与可重复性。在此，我们开发了一个通用校准框架（GCH），用于实现从校准请求到评估结果的端到端委托。在知识基础设施（KI）和验证约定的约束下，智能体定义参数域、观测映射和目标，并生成特定于模型的代码。GCH依据相同的声明检查这些公式化表达，并在数值搜索和评估之前将其冻结，这些后续步骤无需智能体的进一步判断。由智能体编写的工作流在六个模型家族中执行，评估过程可识别出未满足的标准。在雪模型测试中，五个知识引导的规范全部在首次尝试中成功执行，而仅提供模型名称的五个规范则无一成功，实现了经验证的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究开发了通用校准框架（GCH），通过知识基础设施和验证约定约束大语言模型智能体，实现了地球科学模型校准从请求到评估结果的端到端可靠委托，其中知识引导的规范在雪模型测试中首次执行全部成功。
en_tdlr: This study develops a General Calibration Harness (GCH) that enables reliable end-to-end delegation of Earth science model calibration to knowledge-guided LLM agents constrained by a knowledge infrastructure, with all knowledge-guided specifications executing successfully on the first attempt in snow-model tests.
